biome_based_crops.guide.title: Biomes Notebook
biome_based_crops.guide.setup_text: Once the room reaches the required temperature and meets the floor and interior block requirements, it will register as that biome, enabling mobs and other creatures to spawn in it too. Crops and saplings need sky-exposed glass directly above each plant. The rest of the roof can be solid. Biome registration needs an Electrical or Tough As Nails thermoregulator facing into the room. Changing climate needs one AC per 256 interior blocks. Faint air wisps indicate openings. Seal them within one minute, before the climate starts returning to its natural state.
biome_based_crops.ac.selector_usage: Click to cycle forward. Hold Shift or use the left arrow key to cycle backward.
biome_based_crops.greenhouse.status.miss: Install an Electrical or Tough As Nails thermoregulator to register a greenhouse biome.
